about.title: About this site
about.description: What this site is, how the lessons are made and who is behind it.
about.lead: This site helps people prepare for the Knowledge of Dutch Society (KNM) exam of the civic integration.
body: The lessons follow the attainment targets of the KNM exam in force since 1 July 2025 (Staatscourant 2024, 15802). Every test question belongs to a target, and every lesson and page names its sources.

The lessons are drafted with the help of AI and checked against the attainment targets and official sources. They stay marked as drafts until a qualified Dutch-as-a-second-language teacher has reviewed them.
The site uses no real exam questions and is not affiliated with DUO or the government. For the official practice exam, go to inburgeren.nl.
Spotted a mistake? Let us know through the contact page.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: What this site does and does not keep: your progress stays in your own browser.
body: Your progress (your scores and which lessons are open) is kept only in your own browser (localStorage). We never see it.
On the live site we count visits without cookies (Vercel Web Analytics). Nothing is kept that could identify you.
If a script on a page goes wrong, a short error report is sent to our server: the page, the message, the site version and your browser's name. Nothing about you.
If you use the contact form, your message is emailed to us. It is not stored on the site.
